send_message_tool: send a message to a connected messaging platform like telegram, discord, or slack
send_message_tool_list: list all available messaging targets across connected platforms
send_message_tool_telegram: send a telegram message with markdown formatting and media attachments
send_message_tool_discord: send a discord message with forum thread support and media uploads
send_message_tool_slack: send a slack message with mrkdwn formatting to a channel
